meta.titulo: Used Porsche 928 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 928, from 1978 to 1995, with a front-mounted V8. Inspected on 111 points: timing belt, water pump, torque tube and electronics. Twelve-month warranty.

parrafos: The 928 was the car meant to replace the 911 and ended up living alongside it for seventeen years: aluminium front V8, transaxle, body in aluminium and galvanised steel and a grand touring interior. From the 4.5 with 240 hp it moved to the 4.7 of the S, the 32-valve 5.0 of the S4 with 320 hp, the GT and the 5.4-litre GTS with 350 hp.
It is a complex car that punishes neglect and rewards maintenance. A 928 with its belts up to date and healthy electronics is an extraordinary grand tourer; a neglected one is a list of bills.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 928 before selling it
items: Timing belt, tensioner and water pump: the failure that destroys the engine. Date, mileage and parts of the last change.
Torque tube and its centre bearing, clutch on the manuals and automatic gearbox on the rest.
Cooling and oil leaks: radiator, thermostat, cover gaskets and seals.
Electronics: instruments, control units, climate control and window lifts. Everything must work.
Interior and dashboard, which cracks in the sun, and match of options with the Porsche certificate.

parrafos: Every Porsche 928 we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
